With a fortune of $18 billion from Brunei’s oil and gas, he rules as an absolute monarch under strict Sharia law. The Sultan is hosting a grand wedding for his daughter, Princess Azemah, who will marry her cousin. Lavish ceremonies will take place in the Istana Nurul Iman, his palace with 1,788 rooms and 257 gold-adorned bathrooms. The celebrations include traditional rituals and a royal banquet for 2,000 elite guests, who will receive diamond-encrusted gifts. The event also shines a spotlight on Prince Mateen, the Sultan’s son and one of the world’s most eligible bachelors. Brunei’s mix of immense wealth, strict governance, and enduring traditions make it one of the most fascinating and secretive monarchies globally. …...more ...more Show less Transcript Follow along using the transcript.
